name: Le Santa

features.name: Jackpot Boxes
features.description: Four bet-based jackpots that can combine.

review:
Le Santa is Smokey's Christmas heist. As in Le Fisherman, winning positions become Golden Squares, and a Rainbow activates them to reveal coins, clovers, Santa Sacks that collect visible values, or Jackpot Boxes. After everything resolves, the squares reactivate and reveal again, so one Rainbow can pay out several times.

Jackpot Boxes add a fixed-prize layer, with four jackpots tied to your bet that combine if more than one lands. The bonuses start with Silent Heist, and the cap is 20,000x, a step up from Le Fisherman.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen

Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
